tasks.summary_pl: Dla jakich $m$ jedynym całk. pierw. $mx^3+x^2+(m^2-9)x+m$ jest 1?
tasks.summary_en: For which $m$ is 1 the only integer root of $mx^3+x^2+(m^2-9)x+m$?
tasks.statement_en: Determine all values of the parameter m for which the number 1 is the only integer root of the polynomial $W(x)=mx^3+x^2+(m^2-9)x+m$.
tasks.notes: W(1)=m^2+2m-8=0 gives m=-4 or m=2. The key excerpt's minus signs are dropped by the raw-text extraction throughout this passage (e.g. -4x^3, -5x all print without the sign), so its final line 'm=4' is read as m=-4: for m=-4, W(x)=-4x^3+x^2+7x-4 factors as (x-1)(-4x^2-3x+4) with irrational other roots (disc=73), so 1 is the only integer root. For m=2, W(x)=2x^3+x^2-5x+2=(x-1)(2x^2+3x-2), which has the other integer root x=-2, so m=2 is rejected. [verified: ok: W(1)=0 -> m=-4 or 2; m=2 gives extra integer root -2; m=-4 leaves irrational roots (disc 73). Single value -4.]
